svg.title: GenAI Video Briefing Console
svg.desc: GenAI Video Briefing Console: Turns a spoken YouTube video into an executive summary, key ideas, takeaways and a one-line TL;DR. One shared pipeline behind a Gradio app, a CLI and a notebook. 4-part brief from up to 30 minutes of audio.
